desc:
🟡 Eat. Grow. Evolve. 🟡

Start as a tiny Verity and roll around the arena eating orbs to grow 🍬 Get big enough and you can swallow other players whole 😋, but watch out 👀, because someone bigger is always hunting you.

😈 100+ Verities to unlock! As you grow, your Verity transforms into something stranger, scarier and more powerful. Can you reach ♾️ Infinity?

✨ Features
🍬 Eat orbs and players to grow from size 10 to numbers you can’t even read
⬆️ Level up to multiply how much every orb gives you
📖 Collect all 20 Verities in the Index, each with its own look and sound
🏆 Climb the leaderboard and show off your size
🚪 Exit safely to keep your size for next time

💡 Tips
🧍 Stand still for 5 seconds before leaving to save your size
🤖 Use Auto to farm orbs
💨 Bigger players move slower, so use your speed to escape

💀 Got eaten? Get revenge! 🔥

This game runs on a server authoritive model to prevent foul play
